spa_daylight.description: Spa alone rotates the sky, dome and sun by 120 degrees at unchanged energy, elevation and exposure. The ineffective 0.06 normal-strength trial was rejected and 0.18 restored. Source grid heights and native data are unchanged. A bounded 0.25 m mesh represents the existing field within 2.517 cm in the visible core and rejoins the actual old outer triangle planes. Fresh full-route visual review passes; residual tone and rounded-hollow differences lack matched source classification.

singapore_route.description: Singapore-only generated road controls are aligned with Anderson Bridge driver-left opening, with an 8.8 m legal lane and separately accounted kerbs/shoulders/wall thickness. Local smooth joins replace the rejected infinite-axis exit shift. No shared vehicle/camera implementation changes.

malaysia_surface.description: Malaysia alone uses a 16 m legal lane, exact frozen baseline widths for outside pavement, estimated adverse final-corner section and rising-exit warp. Generated paving triangles preserve actual render/contact agreement; Ground queries them outside the protected analytic road/kerb core. Focused source/native regression checks cover old core contact, flat apron contact, pit registration and packed vertex agreement. Other circuit behavior and vehicle tuning remain unchanged.

cota_legal_width.description: COTA alone narrows the image-qualified 2,180–2,380 m approach to 13 m at 2,220–2,340 m, with about 1 m source uncertainty. Paired shoulders and retained-width compensation after the existing runoff minimum preserve the outer envelope within 0.0005012 m. Its field, alignment, elevation and banking remain exact, as does other circuit physical data. Shared handling and camera are unchanged.

resources.scope: Sampled total machine usage, not engine RSS. The hash covers the parsed byte prefix if monitoring continues. Sampling cannot establish every transient peak or job concurrency by itself.

known_limits: Dense native controls do not make reconstructed widths, event radii, height fields or temporary architecture into surveys.

Baku civic paving and Court/north frontages are imported, but the fresh whole-route review retains repetitive ordinary-city facades and downhill-bank views. Six public pedestrian-frontage ray intersections retain grade uncertainty; intersection alone is not a geometric defect or justification to flatten them.

Portimao classified DGT ground yields a maximum 100 m rise of 8.45%, inconsistent with the operator headline 6.2%. The source-definition difference is unresolved; no unsupported vertical rescaling was applied.
Japan now uses registered GSI widths around 10 to 15 m; the operator 16 m extremum is not yet locally registered. Road-top separation at the crossing is not underside clearance.
Zandvoort T3 now uses the measured progressive quadratic bowl and bounded paved bank. Cross-sections and source epochs still carry their stated uncertainties.
Buddh T1-to-T3 has an FIA climb constraint; other terrain retains coarse DSM uncertainty. Generic width controls remain at several venues, including parts of Australia/Canada/China/COTA/Singapore.
Ordinary city facades, vegetation and crowds remain stylized. A visual pass is limited to its exact current scene, whole-route sampled sheets and original critical views.
Automated native/live laps do not establish physical-controller handling or all menu/input paths. Reference clips can contain edited cuts and different cameras.
Only explicit uncapped moving samples establish measured whole-route frame times. Stationary samples and capped image recordings have separate scopes.
Hockenheim visible stand-front join is closed; a hidden mismatch up to 1.479 m remains outside the bounded repair. No broad earth bank was invented to conceal it.

Malaysia’s adverse T15 profile and rising exit are implemented and visually passed. The 16 m legal width is primary-designer supported; 4% mean/7% inner/1% outer crossfall, 15.4 m exit crest and local station warp are estimates, with ±1 m elevation and ±50 m station uncertainty, not civil survey values. Wider original pavement is preserved from the actual frozen 8192-row baseline; outside support-zone discretization differs by at most 4.5 cm.

Monaco’s new bridge, garden and low Kennedy retail are imported and the retail item passes. The opening hillside still fails the visual bar; the mapped stepped terrace/annex lower structure needs separate qualification. Mixed roof-outline vertex heights cannot justify one sloped terrace or a solid full-height prism.
Masarat height 144 ± 12 m, lower wings and terrace/entry dimensions are architectural estimates. Its visual pass does not identify or survey every neighboring Jeddah building.
